issues.reason: 50-foot starting speed already includes Fast and Quadruped. Faster and Nimble Attacks substitutions must reproject speed, not blindly stack extra feet.
Frost Wolf ability vector replaces standard vector; icy tail replaces Everburning Tail. Block until precisely validated.
Weapon-in-jaws equipment slots, quadruped carrying capacity, casting paws, age-gated fire and natural attack routines still require manual tracking.
Beastmaster 2.5-foot fractional reward has malformed source rounding language; Monk speed requires 5 selections. All class favored options remain manual.

sectionInventory.reason: External catalog stored outside race JSON.

excludedSections.reason: Standalone external racial feat and archetype definitions are not part of this race JSON.

features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 WIS, -2 CHA

features.name: Size
features.description: medium creature; apply global size adjustments once.

features.name: Type
features.description: magical beast (seto lion).

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 50 feet; includes Fast and Quadruped (+10 feet each).

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begins speaking Common and Lionese; bonus-language options: Any languages allowed by Linguistics/high Intelligence.

features.name: Cat's Luck
features.description: Once per day, reroll a Reflex saving throw and take the better roll; declare before rolling.

features.name: Altered Slots
features.description: Two jewelry slots on the headdress replace two ring slots; one arm-wrapping slot replaces the hand slot. Hand gear must be specially made at no additional cost.

features.name: Skill Bonus
features.description: +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks.

features.name: Skill Training
features.description: Acrobatics and Climb are always class skills.

features.name: Everburning Tail
features.description: At age 30 or older, tail flame shines normally for 10 feet, brightens the next 10 feet one step, and can cause 1 fire damage per round or ignite flammables on contact; switch on/off at will, not when wet.

features.name: Fast
features.description: +10 feet base speed; already included in the listed 50-foot speed.

features.name: Bite
features.description: One natural bite attack, damage 1d3; primary attack unless using manufactured weapons.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Two 1d4 natural claw attacks; primary unless using manufactured weapons.

features.name: Jaw Weapons
features.description: Can wield light or one-handed weapons in the jaws; other appendages cannot wield manufactured weapons.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Darkvision out to 60 feet.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far as a hume in dim light.

features.name: Quadruped
features.description: Four-legged. +4 CMD versus trip, counts as long for size, 1.5x medium carrying capacity; front paws can perform casting gestures. +10 feet speed is already included in 50-foot base speed.

features.name: Climb
features.description: Climb speed 20 feet, with +8 racial bonus on Climb checks normally granted by climb speed.

features.name: Faster
features.description: Increase normal speed by 10 feet to 60 feet.

features.name: Jumper
features.description: Always count as having a running start for Acrobatics jump checks.

features.name: Nimble Attacks
features.description: Gain Weapon Finesse as bonus feat and give up Bite and Fast (base speed must drop from 50 to 40 feet).

features.name: Large Bite
features.description: Bite damage increases from 1d3 to 1d4.

features.name: Point-Blank Shot
features.description: Gain Point-Blank Shot as bonus feat.

features.name: Throw Anything
features.description: Gain Throw Anything as bonus feat.

features.name: Scent
features.description: Gain scent instead of darkvision and low-light vision.

features.name: Frost Wolf Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 STR, +2 INT, -2 CHA

features.name: Frost Wolf Heritage Benefit
features.description: Alternate appearance: wolf-like heritage with icy tail at age 30 or more, replacing fiery tail; cold tail light reaches 10 feet and improves light for another 10, deals 1 ice damage per round on contact, switchable at will.

heritages.name: Frost Wolf
heritages.description: Alternate appearance: wolf-like heritage with icy tail at age 30 or more, replacing fiery tail; cold tail light reaches 10 feet and improves light for another 10, deals 1 ice damage per round on contact, switchable at will.

replacements.description: Frost Wolf replaces the standard ability score vector and listed racial feature(s); manual review required.

favoredRewards.name: Seto Lion Beastmaster favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +2.5 feet to charge/run distance across rough terrain. Source has malformed rounding language; retain increments, manual adjudication.

favoredRewards.name: Seto Lion Black Mage favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/2 fire damage to fire-damage spells cast by this class.

favoredRewards.name: Seto Lion Blue Mage favored reward
Seto Lion Dragoon favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/6 of an additional 1d6 deadly lancer damage.

favoredRewards.name: Seto Lion Monk favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1 foot to base speed; in combat effective only every five selections.

favoredRewards.name: Seto Lion Ninja favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/4 attacks made while attacking or charging from higher ground.

favoredRewards.name: Seto Lion Red Mage favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/6 melee attacks using spell combat with unarmed strikes or natural weapons.

favoredRewards.name: Seto Lion Thief favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/2 to Stealth and Perception in dim light or darkness.

favoredRewards.name: Seto Lion Warrior favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1 CMD versus each of two chosen combat maneuvers.
